name: Ochi Nobuhiko
source:
“Whoa—so you're bold enough to throw down a challenge to me?
I like your nerve. That's what makes a worthy rival.”

Kazuhito and Souko's childhood friend.

He loves reading beyond all else and dislikes physical labor.

He's both a mood-maker and a trouble-maker.

He takes delight in using his sense of humor and creativity to liven up everyday life.
